    AI Overview
    Final round Sunday coverage of the 2026 Masters (April 12) features TV action on CBS from 2-7 p.m. ET, with extensive streaming on Paramount+, Masters.com, and the Masters App. Early coverage begins at 12 p.m. ET on Paramount+, featuring featured groups, Amen Corner, and holes 15/16. 
    Sunday, April 12, 2026 Coverage Schedule (All Times ET) 
    • 10:15 a.m.–7 p.m.: Featured Groups (Masters.com, Paramount+, Prime Video)
    • 11:45 a.m.–6 p.m.: Featured Holes (Amen Corner) (Masters.com, Paramount+, ESPN App)
    • 12 p.m.–2 p.m.: Early Round 4 Coverage (Paramount+)
    • 2 p.m.–7 p.m.: Final Round TV Coverage (CBS)
    • 7 p.m.: Green Jacket Ceremony (Masters.com, Masters App) 
    Key Viewing Info 
    • TV Channel: CBS (2 p.m. - 7 p.m.)
    • Streaming: Paramount+, Masters.com, Masters App, ESPN App, Prime Video
    • Radio: SiriusXM 
    Rory McIlroy entered Sunday with a share of the lead, looking for his first major championship since 2014.
